guarantees.claim: num_rounds_regular is always assigned to num_rounds_q minus 1 (unsigned 4-bit subtraction).

uncertain_points.claim: cfg_valid_i is only tied to an unused wire (unused_cfg_valid), intended for SVAs; if assertions are not compiled, the input is functionally dead, potentially masking missing control-path usage.
uncertain_points.cond: cfg_valid_i toggles but does not affect any output.
uncertain_points.risk: Verification coverage may be missed; control-path error may go undetected.

uncertain_points.claim: When SecMasking=0, prng_reseed_i is tied to a local wire but not used anywhere, making it dead; any reseed request will be silently ignored.
uncertain_points.risk: If external logic relies on reseed acknowledgment or effect, the module’s behavior is mismatched.

uncertain_points.claim: num_rounds_regular = num_rounds_q - 1; if num_rounds_q can ever be 0 (e.g., due to error or initialization), the subtract wraps to 15, corrupting round count.
uncertain_points.risk: AES round count corruption may lead to under- or over-encryption, breaking cipher security.
